question: Who among the following Indian-American scientists was appointed as the acting Chief of Staff of the US space agency NASA, in February 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhavya Lal**__.

__
 
• **Bhavya Lal, an Indian-American scientist**, was appointed as the acting Chief of Staff of the **US space agency NASA**, in **February 2021**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• In **January 2021**, Lal was the **senior-most White House** appointee and acting chief of staff at **NASA **for the first **100 days** of the **Biden Administration.**
